_readme: Curated recognition for Boston restaurants - sources with no public API.
One entry = one source vouching for one restaurant. A restaurant on three lists has three entries.
Fields: name, address, source (an id from SOURCES in restaurants/scoring.py), source_url (link to the list or article), note (optional, e.g. the year).
place_id / lat / lon are filled in by: python -m restaurants.tools.enrich_recognition

Every entry below is a PLACEHOLDER: a fictional restaurant used by demo mode. Placeholders are ignored when real API keys are in use. Replace them with real entries copied from the source - never guess an award.
